answers.a: Senegal’s central reform is the National Strategy for Continuing Training of State Agents. It aims to improve the quality and relevance of training by renovating its financing and aligning training offered by technical and financial partners with national priorities. Implementation is intended to strengthen cooperation among the ministry responsible for the public service, sector ministries, state agents, training providers and partners. The authorities also plan to adapt the legislative and regulatory framework so that every public agent, from senior managers to operational staff, receives training at least once a year. Training is intended to continue throughout an agent’s career and cover both occupation-specific skills and cross-cutting subjects.

La validation de la Stratégie nationale de formation continue constitue non seulement un jalon important, mais permet également à l’Administration de disposer de ressources humaines de qualité, afin qu’elle puisse jouer son rôle de catalyseur du développement économique et social du Sénégal. answers.a: The principal challenge is that State personnel data are dispersed across several structures. The public-service ministry identifies the need to make those data reliable, available and accessible in real time, and to ensure more coherent tracking between the Ministry of Economy and Finance’s central systems and sectoral systems. These gaps make it harder to maintain a comprehensive view of staffing and payroll. A separate OECD assessment identifies related organisational challenges: overlapping HR initiatives, limited staffing in the institutions involved, insufficient data for informed planning, and a need for stronger dialogue with ministry HR directorates and better monitoring and evaluation. These are documented constraints on public-sector HR management; their effect on HRM-system coverage is an inference, not a directly reported coverage failure.

answers.a: Senegal’s documented HRMIS reform agenda centres on creating a reliable human-resources information system and improving the quality of the personnel data it uses. The measures include unifying the civil-service personnel and payroll files into a single state personnel-data file and certifying data for that file. The programme also lists integrated HR management and the archiving, digitisation and online publication of personnel-administration acts. More broadly, it aims to professionalise HR management, improve workforce and skills planning, and rationalise staffing. These are documented programme measures and objectives; the cited evidence does not establish that they have been completed or that data quality has already improved.

En cohérence avec attributions du Ministre de la Fonction publique et du Renouveau du Service
public, cette action consiste à professionnaliser la gestion des ressources humaines de l’Etat,
assurer la productivité de l’administration publique par la mise en place d’un système de
gestion de la performance en vue d’améliorer sa contribution au développement du pays mais
également de veiller à la rationalisation des effectifs et des compétences des agents de l’Etat.

suivants :

- anticiper les besoins en ressources humaines en qualité et en quantité à court et moyen
termes, en adaptant les emplois, les effectifs et les compétences aux exigences issues
des modifications de l’environnement économique, social et juridique ;
